applicableAreas: Western side near Building 1 pad-mounted transformer
Western side near Building 8 pad-mounted transformer
Area between Buildings 6 and 7 pad-mounted transformer
findings.comment: Proposed trees are planted within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted electrical transformers. Measurements show trees at approximately 0.4 feet from Bldg. 8 transformer (critical violation), 6.2 feet from Bldg. 1 transformer, and 1.9 feet from Bldgs. 6-7 transformer, all violating the minimum 10-foot clearance requirement from pad-mounted equipment. Move all violating trees to minimum 10 feet lateral distance from transformer pads.

applicableAreas: Landscape Plan - trees near overhead electric facilities and pad-mounted transformers
findings.comment: Trees proposed near electric facilities on the landscape plan are identified only by generic symbols (SY, PL, P, M) rather than by species name. Species identification appears only on the separate plant schedule (Sheet 35), not on the landscape plan where the electric infrastructure is shown. Provide a plant legend on the landscape plan that identifies all tree species near overhead and pad-mounted electric facilities by scientific or common name.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan - proposed shade trees (Live Oak, Cedar Elm) and their proximity to electric facilities
findings.comment: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet: Live Oak and Cedar Elm) are not differentiated or labeled on the landscape plan to allow clear verification of clearances from overhead electric facilities. While container sizes distinguish these from smaller ornamental trees, the landscape plan does not explicitly identify which trees are 40+ feet at maturity. Add notation on the landscape plan identifying all large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) near electric facilities.

Trees are proposed within prohibited clearance zones (less than 10 feet from pad-mounted transformers) without documented written approval from Austin Energy. Plans must include explicit written authorization from Austin Energy for each tree positioned within restricted zones, or trees must be relocated to meet minimum clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Underground electric line routes shown on electrical plan
findings.comment: Trees cannot be verified as compliant with the 5-foot minimum clearance from underground electric equipment. While the electrical plan shows underground lines and pull boxes, and the landscape plan shows proposed trees, the documents lack cross-referenced dimensions or clearance markings showing distances between specific proposed trees and underground equipment. Provide dimensioned clearances from proposed trees to all underground electric equipment on the landscape plan, or confirm no trees are within 5 feet of underground equipment.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: Root barrier specifications cannot be verified for trees within 20 feet of underground electric equipment. The landscape details and notes do not specify root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) for trees near underground electric equipment. Provide a schedule or notes on the landscape plan identifying all trees within 20 feet of underground electric equipment and confirming root barrier specifications (4-foot depth, 5-foot offset from equipment) for each, or provide clearance dimensions showing no trees within 20 feet of underground equipment.
